## What's Changed
### Bug Fixes 🐛
* Backport: Accept pipe-separated UUIDs on dependency graph path by @nscuro in https://github.com/DependencyTrack/dependency-track/pull/7745
* Backport: Resolve BOM upload tokens to root workflow runs only by @nscuro in https://github.com/DependencyTrack/dependency-track/pull/7746
* Backport: Skip analyzer when checking if enabled fails by @nscuro in https://github.com/DependencyTrack/dependency-track/pull/7747
* Backport: Fix collection tag missing in project lookup response by @nscuro in https://github.com/DependencyTrack/dependency-track/pull/7748
* Backport: Fix BOM validation failing when XML contains CDATA by @nscuro in https://github.com/DependencyTrack/dependency-track/pull/7750
* Backport: Map unknown or retired vulnerability sources to UNKNOWN in v4-migrator by @nscuro in https://github.com/DependencyTrack/dependency-track/pull/7752
* Backport: Remove eMudhra from container image cacerts by @nscuro in https://github.com/DependencyTrack/dependency-track/pull/7760
* Backport: Fix tag maintenance failing when tag is used only by collection projects by @nscuro in https://github.com/DependencyTrack/dependency-track/pull/7761
* Backport: Fix ineffective ACL check for `/v1/finding/project/{uuid}/analyze` by @nscuro in https://github.com/DependencyTrack/dependency-track/pull/7777
